assessment_summary: I validated the EAM-Portal Bund installation (Next.js 15.3.0 / React 19 static-export portal) in /workspace on Ubuntu 22.04. Inspection confirmed: (1) Node.js v22.23.3 installed at /opt/node22 with symlinks in /usr/local/bin, satisfying the guide's 'Voraussetzung: Node.js 22'; npm 10.9.9. (2) Project files, package.json (scripts dev/build/start/lint), node_modules (317 top-level entries, next 15.3.0 binary present) and build artifact out/ all exist, matching the installation summary; git working tree clean. Behavioral validation: I re-ran every documented guide command. `npm run lint` exited 0 with no warnings/errors. `npm run build` exited 0, compiled and type-checked successfully, and re-exported the 10 static pages to /workspace/out/ — proving the build step is reproducible, not just a one-time success. `npm run dev` started in ~1.8s on http://localhost:3000; curl returned HTTP 200 with the correct <title> on all six application routes and HTTP 404 for an unknown route, confirming full routing and rendering. I additionally verified the static export is deployable as claimed by serving /workspace/out/ with a minimal Node HTTP server on port 8080: index.html and all five section HTML pages returned 200 with correct titles, and the 404 fallback worked. Limitations: python3 was unavailable in the container, so the static export was served with a small Node script instead (equivalent for validation purposes); direct URL-path access (e.g. /ea-repository without .html) requires a web server with clean-URL rewrite rules, which is expected for a static export and not a defect. I performed no installation, repair, or file edits beyond running the documented scripts; all temporary servers and files I created were removed, and I verified ports 3000/8080 are released. All evidence objectively supports that the installation is complete and operational per the guide.
